sub_graphs.title: EIP-3607: Transaction Sender Code Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rule rejecting transactions from addresses with deployed code

nodes.description: Transaction nonce matches expected value for sender account

nodes.label: Retrieve Sender CodeHash

nodes.description: CodeHash value obtained for the sender address

nodes.label: Reject Transaction
nodes.description: Transaction is invalid and must be rejected per EIP-3607

nodes.description: Transaction will not be included in block, considered invalid

nodes.label: Transaction Passed EIP-3607 Check
nodes.description: Transaction sender is valid EOA, can proceed to further validation

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3607: Address Collision Attack Prevention
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundary preventing address collision attacks between EOAs and contracts

nodes.label: Ethereum Address Space
nodes.description: 160-bit address space shared by EOAs and contracts

nodes.label: Attacker Attempts Address Collision
nodes.description: Attacker performs ~2^80 operations to find address collision between EOA and contract

nodes.label: Collision Address Found
nodes.description: Attacker has found address where they control both EOA private key and can deploy contract

nodes.label: Deploy Malicious Contract
nodes.description: Attacker deploys contract to the collision address

nodes.label: Contract Deployed at Collision Address
nodes.description: Contract code exists at address where attacker also has private key

nodes.label: Attempt Transaction from Contract Address
nodes.description: Attacker tries to submit transaction signed with private key from contract address

nodes.label: Attack Blocked by EIP-3607
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because sender has non-empty CodeHash

external_entities.name: Address Collision Attacker

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3607: RPC Simulation Exception
sub_graphs.description: Models the exception allowing eth_call and eth_estimateGas to bypass EIP-3607 checks

nodes.label: RPC Simulation Request Received
nodes.description: eth_call or eth_estimateGas request received with sender parameter

nodes.label: Determine Call Type
nodes.description: Check if this is simulation (eth_call/eth_estimateGas) or real tx submission

nodes.label: Request Is Simulation
nodes.description: Request is eth_call or eth_estimateGas, not actual transaction

nodes.label: Request Is Real Transaction
nodes.description: Request is eth_sendRawTransaction or similar, EIP-3607 applies

nodes.label: Skip Sender Code Check
nodes.description: Allow simulation to proceed without checking sender CodeHash

nodes.label: Enforce Sender Code Check
nodes.description: Apply full EIP-3607 validation for real transactions

nodes.label: Simulation Allowed
nodes.description: Contract-address-as-sender simulation proceeds

edges.label: Simulation runs with contract as sender

external_entities.name: RPC Client
external_entities.description: Application using eth_call or eth_estimateGas to simulate transactions

ambiguities.text: The EIP mentions clients MAY disable the rule for eth_call and eth_estimateGas but does not mandate it
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume client implementations SHOULD allow this exception for developer tooling compatibility, but it is not strictly required.

ambiguities.text: The exact point in state transition where CodeHash check occurs is described as 'after nonce verification' but exact ordering with other checks is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the CodeHash check occurs immediately after nonce verification and before signature recovery or gas checks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The ~2^80 computation cost (~$10 billion) for address collision is a sufficient economic barrier
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If computation costs drop dramatically (e.g., quantum computing advances), address collision attacks could become economically viable despite EIP-3607.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EMPTYCODEHASH constant (0xc5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470) is the correct keccak256 of empty bytes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect constant would either block all transactions (if wrong value) or allow contract senders (if different hash used).

implicit_assumptions.description: There is no legitimate use case for transactions originating from contract addresses
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If future protocol changes introduce legitimate contract-initiated transactions (different from internal calls), EIP-3607 would need revision.

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients implement the CodeHash check consistently at the same point in transaction validation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent implementation could lead to consensus failures if some clients accept transactions that others reject.
